summary: PR #324 (personality-wave-25 + Battle Phase timing primitives, with Daidoji Ebizo/Master Scouts merged in from #326): merged origin/main (Kahoku #316, pile targets #319, hand-played Attack discard #325) keeping both sides; pinned published count recomputed 396 (main) + 3 (Yuki, Ebizo, Master Scouts) = 399. RULES-BEHAVIOR CHANGE per the rules lead's ruling: Daidoji Yuki's Recon Reaction grants his controller Reconnaissance at the battlefield whether he is attacking or defending (all-Scouts requirement decides; a Defender's sits at their OWN province; the opponent gains nothing; first-opportunity claim and Ebizo trigger unchanged). Verification found the old engine gave a defending Yuki a no-op (reconnaissanceNotGained). Fixed with MatchEngine.GrantReconnaissanceAtCurrentBattlefield, and every Reconnaissance reader now asks HasReconnaissanceAtCurrentBattlefield(player): Hiruma Sniper, Keppo, training strike (previously addressed the province owner as 1 - player / target's owner, attacker-only), Nitani, Ebumi, follower exception and Kinto's MovementCannotBeNegated already did. New tests YukiReconnaissance (rewritten), YukiReconnaissanceScoutCondition, ReconnaissanceReadersServeDefenders; decision docs, Kinto note, BLOCKERS and inventory updated.
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests: core 209/209, published 57/57, gold-parity 18/18, gold-quote 20/20, battle-timing 23/23, recon-action 11/11, deck-format 9/9, deck-workshop 10/10; bash tools/check.sh --skip-client all green (Python, AI 14/14, Server 6/6, Client.Transport 5/5). Mutation checks each made the intended test fail: grant attacker-only, grant at 1 - playerId, grant also given to the opponent, Scout condition attacker-only, Sniper/Keppo/Kinto/training-strike readers each attacker-only, reader owner 1 - playerId. Client build and Godot import/smoke passed after the origin/main merge (not re-run for this change, which touches no client code).
remaining: Client (#311) renders new windows/BattleStep.
